[[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had a '''court monkey''' that sat with him at his [[Grappa's palace|palace]] on [[Genon]]. It often got pushed around a lot by Grappa, for he had a wild temper.
